payload.explanation: The business UPDATE (session_5063deb47a1b, pid 511) is blocked waiting on transactionid; pg_blocking_pids identifies session_c240828a4f3c (pid 512) as the sole blocker. That session is 'idle in transaction' after having executed the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1, so it holds the row/transaction lock on product_id=1 and is waiting on ClientRead (client not committing/rolling back). Other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_998195321e72, session_c95e125e7bbf) block no one. Indexes show only the primary key, so no redundant-index or plan issue; table stats show no vacuum/bloat; query stats show no large-data operations. Root cause is an abandoned open transaction holding the lock; the allowed remedy is rollback_session on session_c240828a4f3c, which preserves the business request. Uncertainty: none material; blocker chain is directly observed.
